title: Budget Billing Rider — Determination of the Plan Installment
content:
# Budget Billing Rider — Determination of the Plan Installment

Under each Budget Billing plan the customer is billed a plan installment in place of the bill's actual charges. The basis on which that installment is set, the history it is set from, its rounding, its floor, the bill that first carries it and the date it falls due are fixed per plan as follows.

## Installment basis by plan

| Plan | How the installment is set | Projected usage weather-normalized |
|---|---|---|
| Residential Levelized Billing Plan | The average actual charges of the last 12 regular bills, plus the deferred balance divided by the plan's spread period in months | No |
| Residential Budget Billing Plan | The projected weather-normalized charges for the next 12 months, divided by 12 | Yes |
| Residential FlatBill Plan | The predicted weather-normalized 12-month charges at current rates, multiplied by one plus the plan's FlatBill risk premium, divided by 12 | Yes |
| Commercial Levelized Billing Plan | The average actual charges of the last 12 regular bills, plus the deferred balance divided by the plan's spread period in months | No |
| Commercial Budget Billing Plan | The projected weather-normalized charges for the next 12 months, divided by 12 | Yes |
| Small Business FlatBill Plan | The predicted weather-normalized 12-month charges at current rates, multiplied by one plus the plan's FlatBill risk premium, divided by 12 | Yes |

## History, rounding and floor by plan

| Plan | Regular bills at the address needed to base the installment on the address's own history | Basis where the address's history is shorter | Rounding | Installment floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Levelized Billing Plan | 6 | 12-month usage of the service address under prior occupants priced at current rates | Rounded up to the next whole dollar | $25.00 |
| Residential Budget Billing Plan | 6 | 12-month usage of the service address under prior occupants priced at current rates | Rounded up to the next whole dollar | $25.00 |
| Residential FlatBill Plan | 12 | Not applicable; 12 months of the customer's own history are required | Rounded up to the next whole dollar | $30.00 |
| Commercial Levelized Billing Plan | 6 | 12-month usage of the service address under prior occupants priced at current rates | Rounded up to the next whole dollar | $50.00 |
| Commercial Budget Billing Plan | 6 | 12-month usage of the service address under prior occupants priced at current rates | Rounded up to the next whole dollar | $50.00 |
| Small Business FlatBill Plan | 12 | Not applicable; 12 months of the customer's own history are required | Rounded up to the next whole dollar | $60.00 |

## When the installment is billed and falls due (all six plans)

| Plan | Bill that first carries the plan installment | When the installment falls due |
|---|---|---|
| Residential Levelized Billing Plan | The first regular bill issued after enrollment | On the due date of the bill carrying it |
| Residential Budget Billing Plan | The first regular bill issued after enrollment | On the due date of the bill carrying it |
| Residential FlatBill Plan | The first regular bill issued after enrollment | On the due date of the bill carrying it |
| Commercial Levelized Billing Plan | The first regular bill issued after enrollment | On the due date of the bill carrying it |
| Commercial Budget Billing Plan | The first regular bill issued after enrollment | On the due date of the bill carrying it |
| Small Business FlatBill Plan | The first regular bill issued after enrollment | On the due date of the bill carrying it |

## Points of judgement

- **Short history.** On the four levelized and budget plans, an address with fewer than 6 regular bills has its installment based on the 12-month usage of that service address under prior occupants, priced at current rates. On the two FlatBill plans there is no substitute basis: 12 months of the customer's own history are required.
- **Rounding.** Every plan rounds the installment up to the next whole dollar. A computed $87.01 becomes $88; a computed $87.00 is already a whole dollar and stays $87. (Hypothetical amounts.)
- **Floor.** The rounded installment is never set below the plan's floor. On the Residential Budget Billing Plan a computed $19.40 rounds up to $20 and is then set at the $25.00 floor; on the Commercial Budget Billing Plan a computed $63.20 rounds up to $64, which is above the $50.00 floor and stands. (Hypothetical amounts.)
- **Weather normalization.** The two levelized plans work from actual charges already billed and are not weather-normalized; the two budget plans and the two FlatBill plans project usage on a weather-normalized basis.
